paragraphs: Coordinate the blinded validation, preserve both locked human records, and derive a consensus human reference standard. The machine-only crosswalk is intentionally kept outside Google Docs.
Reviewer 1 workspace: scVI Human Validation — Reviewer 1 (Blinded)
Reviewer 2 workspace: scVI Human Validation — Reviewer 2 (Blinded, paginated)
Assignment: share each reviewer document only with its assigned reviewer. Do not share this consensus document until both independent formal reviews are locked.
Calibration: both reviewers complete CAL-01 to CAL-03 independently, discuss them, and freeze the codebook before formal validation.
Independent review: reviewers complete all 50 HV records in their own different orders without viewing the other document.
Lock: record completion outside the document and prevent answer changes before reconciliation.
Reconciliation: copy both locked records into the matching HV row below; discuss disagreements only; enter the consensus result.
Unresolved reference: use REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED when the two reviewers cannot agree. Never force a label.

Analysis boundary: use the private local sampling crosswalk only after consensus is frozen. The 40 machine-classified studies support weighted accuracy metrics; the 10 abstention states are a separate process audit.
